An Addis Ababa welcome

More than coffee.
A place to belong.

Established in 2011, Darik Coffee brings the warmth of Ethiopian coffee and local hospitality to everyday life across Addis Ababa.

We believe the best moments happen when people gather: around a freshly brewed cup, a familiar flavor, and a table with room for one more.
